profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Spectrum
profile.summary:
Results-driven Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in incident management,
customer support engineering, and IT solutions implementation. I specialize in ensuring
system reliability, mitigating spam/abuse, and resolving critical incidents with precision
and efficiency. My expertise includes reducing production downtime, leading high-impact
projects like a $6M email migration for 2M+ customers, and optimizing email deliverability
through Splunk-based root cause analysis.

With hands-on experience in Microsoft Office, Cisco Routing and Switching, Active
Directory, VMware vSphere, VDI, and Microsoft Exchange, I bring a strong technical
foundation to every role. I excel in ITIL-aligned incident management, SLA compliance, and
cross-functional collaboration, ensuring seamless operations and exceptional customer
experiences.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology from Southern Polytechnic State
University. As a proactive problem-solver, I am committed to continuous learning and
delivering solutions that meet the highest standards of performance and security.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated incident management best practices—leveraging risk analysis and ITIL-aligned protocols—toreduce production downtime by 30% and ensure 100% SLA compliance, while enhancing trust andsafety measures and addressing spam/abuse challenges.
• Managed critical incidents and resolved 50+ high-priority executive escalations, minimizing downtime,ensuring SLA compliance, and earning leadership recognition.
• Optimized customer retention and email deliverability by using Splunk for root cause analysis, cuttingrecurring issue resolution time by 25% through enhanced troubleshooting documentation.
• Led weekly Scrum meetings to resolve incident-related challenges and drive efficient solutions.• Promoted to Subject Matter Expert for Okta Identity Management and Email Platforms; providedtechnical leadership and trained 20+ team members.• Improved cross-functional efficiency by 20% by streamlining incident resolution with internal teams andthird-party vendors (Okta, ProofPoint, Open Xchange, RingCentral).
• Resolved 50+ executive escalations for email issues, earning leadership and customer recognition, whiledeveloping streamlined troubleshooting and escalation workflows.
• Led a seamless email migration for 2M+ customers, transitioning Cox Residential to Yahoo and CoxBusiness to Everymail, saving the company $6M.
• Collaborated with QA to identify and resolve pre-release software bugs.

positions.title: Senior Network Engineer
positions.description:
• Network Design amp; Capacity Planning: Extensive experience designing fiber PON networks, including GPON, XGS-PON, and FTTH architectures, ensuring scalability and future-proofing for high-capacity broadband services.
• Demand Forecasting amp; Coverage Analysis: Expertise in analyzing demand trends, conducting feasibility studies, and performing geographic coverage assessments to optimize fiber deployment and minimize operational costs.
• Equipment Selection amp; Configuration: Proficient in selecting and configuring OLTs, ONTs, splitters, and other key components to ensure seamless integration and performance within PON networks.
• Permitting amp; Construction Coordination: Strong background in coordinating with permitting authorities and managing construction timelines to ensure efficient deployment of fiber infrastructure, from backbone to last-mile connections
• Led network capacity planning efforts, forecasting future bandwidth requirements and scalability needs based on business growth projections.
• Developed and maintained network capacity models and tools to assess network performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend optimization strategies
• Implemented automation scripts and workflows to streamline capacity management processes and improve efficiency
.• Developed network capacity reports and dashboards to provide visibility into network performance metrics and capacity utilization levels
.• Conducted network performance testing and validation to assess the impact of new services or applications on existing infrastructure.
• Collaborated with network engineering teams to evaluate and deploy new technologies for increasing network capacity and resiliency.
• Conducted capacity planning meetings and discussions with stakeholders to align network capacity initiatives with business objectives.
• Assisted in the development and documentation of network architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, and best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Presentations · Networking · Cybersecurity · Integration Strategies · Customer Support · Internet Security · Incident Response · Problem Solving · Incident Management

positions.title: System Administrator II
positions.description:
• Managed user accounts with Active Directory (modifications, additions, deletions).
• Administered email accounts through Microsoft Exchange and Office 365.
• Maintained 50+ client networks, including switches, firewalls, backups, and VOIP systems.
• Performed configuration changes on Cisco switches and resolved connectivity issues.
• Monitored client environments using SolarWinds MSP N-Able for proactive system maintenance.
• Oversaw data backups, restorations, and issue resolution using Veeam, Revive, Backup Exec, and
NetApp.
positions.insights: Skills: Networking · Cybersecurity · Customer Support · Internet Security · Hardware · Problem Solving

positions.title: Design and Configurations Technician and Network Support Engineer
positions.description:
• Troubleshot and configured phone systems using Broadsoft.
• Handled escalations using JIRA ticketing system.
• Provided superior customer service by diagnosing and resolving technical issues within pre-defined
SLAs.
• Utilized internal knowledge base to resolve customer troubleshooting requests.
positions.insights: Skills: Networking · Customer Support · Problem Solving

positions.title: IT Analyst Mobility Intern
positions.description:
• Managed projects focused on cost optimization and mobility initiatives worldwide.
• Collaborated with IT delivery teams for project execution and ongoing support.
• Gathered and documented business requirements, built project scopes, and conducted User
Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Developed mobile technology roadmap to align with long-term business value.

positions.title: Tier 1 Technical Support
positions.description:
• Provided technical support and customer service
• Familiar with troubleshooting basic infrastructure
• Identify router issues, internet connection (WAN, LAN, TCP/IP settings) , PC issues, VOIP, or if there is a network issue
• Established customer’s Email client: Outlook, Apple Mail, Windows Mail and etc
• Partner with NOC team to identify predictive analytical techniques to identify probable network outages
positions.insights: Skills: Networking · Customer Support · Problem Solving

projects.title: Capstone Cyber Threats Project
projects.description: A semester long project that consist of constant data collection on cyber threat related research that are going on in the world. Cyber threats are happening all over and any company or person could be at risk. We collect all the information we can daily as a group. We also will build a database to have all the information that are collected and sorted out by date and threat levels.

projects.title: Hospital Database
projects.description: Build a database that a patient can input their information for a treatment that will be needed. This project was completed using PHP and MySQL.
